claim.claim_context: Active atomic proposition P-03 from the frozen ASA 25/261 Premium Grounding claim registry (origin F02 in context; type IMPLIED; THERAPEUTIC; CONDITION-SPECIFIC; PRODUCT-SPECIFIC). Frozen evidence-preparation state: VERY LIMITED DIRECT EVIDENCE. Routing: STANDARD BIOMEDICAL ADJUDICATION
claim.claim_scope: REPORTING-SENSITIVE | REPLICATION ABSENT | PRODUCT EQUIVALENCE UNCERTAIN
claim.claim_source_reference: INSPEKTORIUM Premium Grounding ASA 25/261 Final Evidence Freeze v1, sections 12/48; evidence cut-off 2026-08-22
claim.intended_reader_or_audience: General consumer audience of a website health advertisement.

contradicting_or_limiting: H01 denominator conflict (60 recruited versus 50 in the table)
No replication beyond the grey report

evidence_items.text: Ober 2000, ESD Journal grey report: grounded conductive sleep pad versus ungrounded/sham over one month, with large subjective sleep, stiffness and pain percentages. 60 said recruited but outcome-table totals reach 50.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: The only direct stiffness observation; a grey report with a denominator conflict and no reported allocation or validated-scale detail.

evidence_items.text: Delayed-onset-muscle-soreness work provides indirect mechanism context only.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Induced soreness in healthy young men is not the advertised muscle-stiffness complaint.

evidence_items.text: No validated stiffness endpoint in a defined population, and no replication of H01, were located.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Neither a measurement instrument nor an independent confirmation exists.

evidence.evidence_sufficiency_rationale: A single grey report with unresolved internal arithmetic and no validated endpoint cannot support a therapeutic claim.

detected.rationale: A symptom benefit is asserted from a grey report whose own participant totals conflict and which used no validated stiffness measure.
Induced muscle soreness in healthy young men is extended to general muscle stiffness in the advertised audience.

reader_impact.likely_reader_misunderstanding: That a measured, reliable stiffness benefit exists.
reader_impact.risk_rationale: Muscle stiffness is usually benign; the main risk is misplaced purchase reliance.

recommended_revision.rewrite_rationale: Out of scope for RUN 001: this run adjudicates the frozen wording only. Replacement claim language occurs downstream after verdict freeze.

uncertainty.alternative_label_rationale: No specific frozen label applies; the error is asserting an effect on the strength of a grey report with internal denominator conflicts and no validated endpoint.
missing_evidence: H01 denominator conflict (60 recruited versus 50 in the table)
No replication beyond the grey report
scope_limitations: Adjudication is bounded to the frozen evidence substrate at the 2026-08-22 cut-off. No new literature discovery was performed.
The ASA regulatory outcome is quarantined and contributes no scientific inference.
unresolved_questions: A validated stiffness endpoint in a defined population has never been measured.

verdict.verdict_summary: The only direct support is a grey trade-journal report whose recruitment total (60) conflicts with its own outcome-table total (50), which used no validated stiffness instrument and has never been replicated.
